    "Revenue":             [5000000.0, 5600000.0, 6800000.0],
    "COGS":                [3000000.0, 3400000.0, 3900000.0],

    "Shareholders_Equity": [2500000.0, 2700000.0, 2900000.0]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(fin_data)

# ==========================================
# STEP 2: COMPUTE CORE AUDIT RATIOS
# ==========================================
# 1. Liquidity Ratios
df["Current_Ratio"] = (df["Current_Assets"] / df["Current_Liabilities"]).round(2)
df["Quick_Ratio"]   = ((df["Current_Assets"] - df["Inventory"]) / df["Current_Liabilities"]).round(2)

# 2. Solvency Ratios
df["Debt_to_Equity"]    = (df["Total_Debt"] / df["Shareholders_Equity"]).round(2)
df["Interest_Coverage"] = (df["EBIT"] / df["Interest_Expense"]).round(2)

# 3. Profitability Ratios
df["Gross_Margin_%"] = (((df["Revenue"] - df["COGS"]) / df["Revenue"]) * 100).round(2)
df["Net_Margin_%"]   = ((df["Net_Profit"] / df["Revenue"]) * 100).round(2)
df["ROE_%"]          = ((df["Net_Profit"] / df["Shareholders_Equity"]) * 100).round(2)

# 4. Efficiency / Working Capital Ratios
df["Inventory_Turnover"]   = (df["COGS"] / df["Inventory"]).round(2)
df["Receivables_Days"]     = ((df["Trade_Receivables"] / df["Revenue"]) * 365).round(1)

# ==========================================

df["Collection_Flag"] = np.where(df["Receivables_Days"] > 60, "AUDIT ALERT: Slow Collections / Fictitious Sales Risk", "OK")

# ==========================================

# ==========================================

    "Current_Ratio", "Quick_Ratio", "Debt_to_Equity", "Interest_Coverage",
    "Gross_Margin_%", "Net_Margin_%", "ROE_%", "Inventory_Turnover", "Receivables_Days"
]

import io
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill
from google.colab import files

# ==========================================
# STEP 1: UPLOAD REAL SCREENER.IN EXCEL FILE
# ==========================================
print("Upload the .xlsx file downloaded from Screener.in:")
uploaded = files.upload()
filename = next(iter(uploaded))

# Read the hidden 'Data Sheet' where Screener stores all raw 10-year tables
raw_sheet = pd.read_excel(io.BytesIO(uploaded[filename]), sheet_name="Data Sheet", header=None)

# ==========================================
# STEP 2: PARSE & TRANSPOSE P&L AND BALANCE SHEET
# ==========================================
def extract_screener_block(df_raw, start_marker, stop_markers):
    """Finds a financial statement block in Screener's Data Sheet and transposes years into rows."""
    col0 = df_raw[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
    start_idx = df_raw[col0 == start_marker].index[0] + 1

    # Locate the next section header to know where this block ends
    end_idx = len(df_raw)
    for idx in range(start_idx + 1, len(df_raw)):
        if col0.iloc[idx] in stop_markers:
            end_idx = idx
            break

    block = df_raw.iloc[start_idx:end_idx].dropna(how="all").copy()
    block.columns = block.iloc[0]               # Set the date row ('Mar 2017'...'Mar 2026') as headers
    block = block.iloc[1:].set_index(block.columns[0])
    block.index = block.index.astype(str).str.strip()

    # Transpose so Financial Years become rows and Line Items become columns
    transposed = block.T.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").dropna(how="all")
    transposed.index.name = "Financial_Year"
    return transposed.reset_index()

pnl_df = extract_screener_block(raw_sheet, "PROFIT & LOSS", ["QUARTERS", "BALANCE SHEET", "CASH FLOW"])
bs_df  = extract_screener_block(raw_sheet, "BALANCE SHEET", ["CASH FLOW", "RATIOS", "DERIVED"])

# Merge P&L and Balance Sheet on Financial_Year
df = pd.merge(pnl_df, bs_df, on="Financial_Year", suffixes=("_PnL", "_BS"))

# Map Screener's standard line-item labels safely
sales     = df["Sales"]
net_prof  = df["Net profit"]
op_profit = df["Operating Profit"]
interest  = df["Interest"].replace(0, np.nan)
equity    = df["Equity Share Capital"] + df["Reserves"]
debt      = df["Borrowings"]
inv       = df.get("Inventory", pd.Series(0, index=df.index)).fillna(0)
rec       = df.get("Receivables", pd.Series(0, index=df.index)).fillna(0)
cash      = df.get("Cash & Bank", pd.Series(0, index=df.index)).fillna(0)
curr_liab = df.get("Other Liabilities", pd.Series(np.nan, index=df.index))

# ==========================================
# STEP 3: COMPUTE 10-YEAR AUDIT RATIOS
# ==========================================

df["Net_Margin_%"]       = ((net_prof / sales) * 100).round(2)
df["ROE_%"]              = ((net_prof / equity) * 100).round(2)
df["Debt_to_Equity"]     = (debt / equity).round(2)
df["Interest_Coverage"]  = (op_profit / interest).round(2)
df["Receivables_Days"]   = ((rec / sales) * 365).round(1)
df["Inventory_Days"]     = ((inv / sales) * 365).round(1)

# Approximate Current Ratio using Screener's Balance Sheet buckets
approx_curr_assets = inv + rec + cash
df["Approx_Current_Ratio"] = (approx_curr_assets / curr_liab).round(2)

# ==========================================
# STEP 4: SA 520 AUTOMATED RED-FLAG ALERTS
# ==========================================
df["Solvency_Flag"]   = np.where(df["Debt_to_Equity"] > 1.0, "ALERT: High Leverage (>1.0x)", "OK")
df["Collection_Flag"] = np.where(df["Receivables_Days"] > 75, "ALERT: Slow Collections (>75 Days)", "OK")
df["Coverage_Flag"]   = np.where(df["Interest_Coverage"] < 2.5, "ALERT: Weak Interest Cover", "OK")

# ==========================================
# STEP 5: EXPORT FORMATTED 10-YEAR EXCEL REPORT
# ==========================================
company_name = filename.rsplit(".", 1)[0]
output_file = f"SA520_Real_Audit_{company_name}.xlsx"

ratio_cols = [
    "Operating_Margin_%", "Net_Margin_%", "ROE_%",
    "Debt_to_Equity", "Interest_Coverage",
    "Approx_Current_Ratio", "Receivables_Days", "Inventory_Days"
]

scorecard = df.set_index("Financial_Year")[ratio_cols].T.reset_index().rename(columns={"index": "Audit_Ratio"})
flags_df  = df[["Financial_Year", "Solvency_Flag", "Collection_Flag", "Coverage_Flag"]]

header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="1F4E78", end_color="1F4E78", fill_type="solid")
header_font = Font(color="FFFFFF", bold=True)
alert_fill  = PatternFill(start_color="FFC7CE", end_color="FFC7CE", fill_type="solid")
alert_font  = Font(color="9C0006", bold=True)

with pd.ExcelWriter(output_file, engine="openpyxl") as writer:
    scorecard.to_excel(writer, sheet_name="1_10Yr_Ratio_Scorecard", index=False)
    flags_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name="2_SA520_Risk_Alerts", index=False)
    df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name="3_Full_Extracted_Data", index=False)

    for sheet_name, ws in writer.sheets.items():
        for cell in ws[1]:
            cell.fill = header_fill
            cell.font = header_font
        for col in ws.columns:
            max_len = max(len(str(cell.value or "")) for cell in col)
            ws.column_dimensions[col[0].column_letter].width = max_len + 5
        for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2):
            for cell in row:
                if isinstance(cell.value, float):
                    cell.number_format = "#,##0.00"
                elif isinstance(cell.value, str) and "ALERT" in cell.value:
                    cell.fill = alert_fill
                    cell.font = alert_font

print(f"\n--- 10-YEAR SA 520 RATIO SCORECARD: {company_name.upper()} ---")
print(scorecard.to_string(index=False))
files.download(output_file)
